title: Inspect and extend: Test protocol edges and plan a compatible server demo
objective: Use the real implementation in `test/chat.test.ts` to demonstrate and safely improve fake socket assertions, endpoint test cases, dependency and provider review.
problem: Tests simulate server messages without a network. Use them to understand expected envelopes, then plan authenticated integration and server-version checks as future work. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `test/chat.test.ts` and the related project files: test/chat.test.ts; package.json; README.md.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to fake socket assertions, endpoint test cases, dependency and provider review.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: Current Rocket.Chat docs recommend REST by default and mark DDP method calls deprecated; the custom method names in this source have not been verified against a server.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: Tests simulate server messages without a network. Use them to understand expected envelopes, then plan authenticated integration and server-version checks as future work.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `test/chat.test.ts`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
